articles.headline: US bans DeepSeek from civilian government IT systems over national security concerns
articles.summary: The US ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek AI products and related services from IT systems, citing national security and data-transfer risks. This raises compliance and vendor-risk concerns for enterprises that use or evaluate foreign AI tools, especially in regulated sectors and government-adjacent supply chains.

articles.headline: Siemens Software Center flaw exploited in ClickFix attacks
articles.summary: A high-severity DLL sideloading vulnerability in Siemens Software Center has reportedly been exploited, creating an operational risk for industrial and enterprise environments. Businesses using Siemens software should treat this as a patching and exposure-priority issue because exploitation can lead to code execution with service-level privileges.

articles.headline: Japan plans certifications for data centers and cloud services to curb China risk
articles.summary: Japan is preparing certifications for data centers and cloud providers and wants finance and other critical sectors to use secure infrastructure. That matters for multinational firms because it could reshape cloud procurement, compliance checks, and where sensitive workloads can be hosted.
